overview: A watch entry for UN internships in Kinshasa. On 9 November 2026 no UN internship based in the DRC was open on the agencies' own portals that could be read (UNDP, UNFPA, UNICEF, WFP, UNESCO, WHO); the last UNFPA Kinshasa internships closed on 7 October 2026. UNDP had internships that can be done from home (see the separate UNDP records).
deadline_text: No open UN internship in the DRC was found on 9 November 2026. Official portals read: UNDP (one DRC vacancy, the Kinshasa Monitoring and Evaluation and Risk Management Team Lead, a staff post; several home-based internships open worldwide), UNFPA (no DRC posting), WFP (four DRC postings: Business Support Associate - Mechanic and PSEA Officer in Kinshasa, Management Services Officer in Goma, site maintenance assistant in Beni; no internship), UNICEF (three DRC vacancies: a temporary P-4 post in Bunia and two national consultancies; no internship), UNESCO ('There are currently no' jobs for Kinshasa) and WHO (two internships, both in Geneva). unvacancies.org listed nine Kinshasa posts, none an internship: two National UN Volunteer posts with MONUSCO (Political Affairs Assistant and Child Protection Officer, closing 17 November 2026) each require three years of experience. untalent.org and unjobs.org refused automated reading (bot check, HTTP 403); UN Careers and the UN Volunteers platform show no listings to an automated reader; the UNOPS portal returned a certificate error, which was not bypassed.
expected_next_cycle: Agencies post internship calls at different times of the year; none was open in the DRC on 9 November 2026. Set an alert for Kinshasa on untalent.org and unjobs.org.
potential_issues: A watch entry, not an open call
